data.title: OpenAI designs working hardware device in under one week with GPT-6
data.description: OpenAI used GPT-6 and Astra to design a working Codex device in under a week, while testing engineering applications with Mazda.
data.author: Aamir Khollam
data.keywords: Astra, CAD software, circuit boards, Codex, computer-aided design, engineering automation, GPT-6, hardware engineering, hardware prototyping, OpenAI, PCB design
